Subject: Multi-vendor listing repricing & evidence request for ACME renewal

Hi Liam / Priya —

ACME's renewal with us is coming up in mid-September (see HubSpot HS-ACME-3492). They indicated they will consolidate more workloads onto our hosted offering, which changes the expected take rate and has triggered a marketplace fee/credit review on their side. Before we commit to renewal pricing, ACME has asked us to:

- Align listing fee cadence across AWS and GCP (they want a single effective listing fee to simplify procurement)
- Provide recent marketplace usage and credit evidence for the last two quarters
- Confirm any onboarding / co-sell credits we can commit to as part of the renewal

Attaching a short P&L snapshot they asked us to share and a template for the usage evidence request. Can each of you confirm:

1) Whether Amazon/GCP can provide a temporary listing fee adjustment or one-off credit for a Q4 renewal (range and eligibility criteria).
2) What specific marketplace artifacts you need from us/ACME to validate credits (reporting IDs, invoice samples, contract dates).
3) Typical lead time for DocuSign/offer updates (we're trying to lock terms by 2026-09-02).

ACME contact: Julia Hart (procurement) — copying her on the next message once we have clarity.

Thanks — brief answers welcome, we can take details offline.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Sr. Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference

Karthik —

Thanks for the note. Short answers below:

1) Amazon can offer a time-limited listing fee reduction (we typically do 6–12 month promotional adjustments) — ballpark 8–12% off list, subject to minimum commitment levels. We can also convert a portion of listing fees into marketplace credits for co-sell activity, depending on spend and joint GTM plan.

2) To validate credits we need: marketplace customer ID (merchant/account ID), invoice samples for the last two quarters, and a service usage CSV (we can accept the template you attached). If ACME is the buyer on invoices, we can match on the order id + marketplace id.

3) DocuSign timeline: once terms are agreed, 3–5 business days from our side for standard partner amendment. If legal redlines are needed it can extend.

If it's helpful I can draft an initial credit offer and send to ACME + Redwood for confirmation.

Regards,
Liam Porter | Sr. Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace

B) Larger multi-year commit with deeper listing fee rebate but longer lock-in.

We need a call with ACME + both marketplaces this week if possible so we can close by 2026-09-02. Julia — can you confirm ACME's internal approval timeline?
